scope: Restore the Publish 14.1 Brawler berserk1 command as an authenticated real-client HAM-to-timed-state transaction with restart-safe expiration and reversible evidence.

findings: The exact retained 94-column row routes berserk1 to the actor hook, permits optional other targeting, executes outside the combat queue, rejects an already-berserk actor through the state mask, and is visible at client level two.
combat_brawler_novice grants berserk1 and no berserk modifier; the master box later grants berserk2 and berserk=20.

Pinned Core3 requires melee or unarmed combat, succeeds when random 0..100 plus berserk is at least 25, and charges Strength-, Quickness-, and Focus-adjusted base costs of 100 Health, 100 Action, and 50 Mind only when every current pool is strictly greater than its cost.

Success sets the berserk state for 20 seconds. The restored player receiver persists an absolute expiry and generation-checks callbacks so relogin can rearm the remaining interval and stale timers cannot clear a newer activation.

eligibility: current weapon classified as melee or unarmed
random 0..100 plus berserk skill modifier at least 25
current Health, Action, and Mind each strictly greater than adjusted cost
productionContract.durability: absolute server-game-time expiry objvar plus generation-checked callback and OnLogin rearm

liveFixture.expectedCosts: calculated from the fixture character's snapshotted Strength, Quickness, and Focus using the production adjustment formula
liveFixture.fixtureIsolation: deterministic roll and telemetry require exact player OID, station ID, fixture protocol, and prepared root
liveFixture.cleanupPolicy: clear fixture berserk state and expiry; restore the six snapshotted current values and maxima, accepting only monotonic primary current/max increases from ordinary regeneration or the retained skill system's legacy stat-layout repair; restore skill points and fixture skills; retain the lifecycle marker on any incomplete restoration; then prove repeated cleanup idempotence

included: authoritative command registration and Brawler novice ownership
production chance, weapon, adjusted HAM, strict-pool, state, persistence, relogin-rearm, and stale-timer semantics
real-client nonqueued activation, natural 20-second expiry, cleanup, idempotence, and server health
deferred: berserk2 master behavior, which is the next shared-state milestone
